title: Olive Young says unauthorized external access to a business system exposed names and contacts of 790 people
date_note: Newsis says Olive Young's notice of 26 November dates the unauthorized access to 23 November.
summary: Newsis reports that Olive Young said in a 26 November notice that unauthorized external access to a company business system on 23 November exposed some personal data. Names and contact details of 790 people were exposed: 639 employees, 106 partner-company staff and 45 customers. Payment information and passwords were not leaked, Newsis says.
plain: Newsis reports that Olive Young said an outside party reached an internal system and exposed names and contact details of 790 people. Payment information and passwords were not leaked.
exec: Olive Young told people in a notice that names and contacts of 790 people, mostly staff, were exposed, Newsis reports.
action: Olive Young urged people to be careful of impersonation texts and emails, Newsis reports.
geo_basis: country as stated by the source; city not stated

sources.name: Newsis: 올리브영, 해킹 공격에 직원·고객 포함 790명 이름·연락처 등 개인정보 유출

evidence.quote: 이름과 연락처 등 개인정보가 유출된 인원은 790명으로 이 중 45명이 일반 고객이다.

validation.note: Only Newsis read; it relays Olive Young's 26 November notice. The notice itself was not read.
